title: ODG-NoMaD: Overhead-Camera Direction-Guided NoMaD
abstract: arXiv:2608.21395v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: NoMaD [31] is a learned vision-navigation policy that unifies goal-conditioned navigation and exploration in a single goal-masked diffusion policy. In an unseen environment, however - where neither a goal image nor a topological map is available - it can only explore undirectedly, wandering without global awareness. We present ODG-NoMaD, which gives NoMaD's exploration mode a global sense of where to proceed, without retraining the policy. An overhead depth camera is used once on deployment to build an occupancy map and plan a global path, which is segmented to yield a desired heading; a per-frame traversability map from the robot's onboard depth then refines this into a collision-free direction. The gradient of a cosine direction cost is injected into the final denoising steps, rotating sampled trajectories toward this direction while preserving the multimodality of exploration. translated_title: ODG-NoMaD：基于顶置摄像头方向引导的NoMaD导航策略
translated_abstract: NoMaD [31]是一种学习型视觉导航策略，通过单一的目标掩蔽扩散策略统一了目标条件导航和探索功能。然而，在未知环境中——既没有目标图像也没有拓扑地图可用时——它只能无方向地探索，缺乏全局感知地漫游。我们提出了ODG-NoMaD，它为NoMaD的探索模式提供了全局的方向感，而无需重新训练策略。在部署时，使用一次顶置深度摄像头来构建占据地图并规划全局路径，该路径被分割以产生期望的航向；机器人机载深度摄像头生成的逐帧可通行性地图随后将其细化为无碰撞的方向。余弦方向成本的梯度被注入到最终的去噪步骤中，将采样的轨迹旋转朝向该方向，同时保留探索的多模态性。在有无随机障碍物的模拟办公室环境中进行了测试。
tldr: ODG-NoMaD通过顶置摄像头构建全局地图并引导航向，在不重新训练NoMaD策略的情况下，为未知环境中的探索提供全局方向感知，同时保持探索的多模态性。
en_tdlr: ODG-NoMaD leverages an overhead camera to build a global map and guide heading, providing global direction awareness for exploration in unseen environments without retraining the NoMaD policy, while preserving exploration multimodality.
